name: Motion Primitives
summary: Open-source MIT motion components for React — CLI + registry JSON on motion-primitives.com.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 33 registry items in https://motion-primitives.com/c/registry.json — not a full inventory.
Primary install path is the motion-primitives CLI; shadcn-compatible JSON also lives under /c/{name}.json.
Import path after CLI: `@/components/core/{slug}` per docs examples.
LICENSE file is LICENCE.md (British spelling) at repo root — MIT Copyright (c) 2024 ibelick.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Text Scramble
components.summary: Text that scrambles through random characters before revealing.
components.copyCode:
npx motion-primitives@latest add text-scramble

import { TextScramble } from "@/components/core/text-scramble"

<TextScramble className="font-mono text-sm uppercase">Text Scramble</TextScramble>

copyPrompt.text: Use Motion Primitives component `Text Scramble` (slug `text-scramble`) from https://motion-primitives.com/docs/text-scramble. Install with `npx motion-primitives@latest add text-scramble` after Tailwind + `npm install motion` (and typically lucide-react / cn utils — see https://motion-primitives.com/docs/installation). Registry JSON also published at https://motion-primitives.com/c/text-scramble.json. Import from `@/components/core/text-scramble` after CLI add (path may follow project aliases). Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + `motion`. Free & open source MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ibelick/motion-primitives/main/LICENCE.md — note British spelling LICENCE.md).

components.name: Morphing Dialog
components.summary: Dialog that morphs from a trigger into expanded content via shared layout.
components.copyCode:
npx motion-primitives@latest add morphing-dialog

import {
  MorphingDialog,
  MorphingDialogTrigger,
  MorphingDialogContent,
  MorphingDialogContainer,
  MorphingDialogTitle,
  MorphingDialogClose,
} from "@/components/core/morphing-dialog"

<MorphingDialog transition={{ type: "spring", bounce: 0.05, duration: 0.25 }}>
  <MorphingDialogTrigger>Open</MorphingDialogTrigger>
  <MorphingDialogContainer>
    <MorphingDialogContent>
      <MorphingDialogTitle>Title</MorphingDialogTitle>
      <MorphingDialogClose />
    </MorphingDialogContent>
  </MorphingDialogContainer>
</MorphingDialog>
